parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.processing_errors (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,

    error_stage,
    error_code,
    error_message,
    technical_details,

    severity,
    status,
    retry_count,

    workflow_name,
    workflow_execution_id,

    source_message_id,
    context,

    occurred_at
)
VALUES (
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,

    'UNKNOWN',
    'N8N_WORKFLOW_FAILURE',

    $1::text,
    $2::text,

    $3::text,
    'OPEN',
    0,

    $4::text,
    $5::text,

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_id',
        NULLIF($6::text, ''),

        'failed_node',
        NULLIF($7::text, ''),

        'execution_url',
        NULLIF($8::text, ''),

        'error_description',
        NULLIF($9::text, ''),

        'source',
        $10::text,

        'captured_at',
        $11::text,

        'requires_alert',
        $12::boolean
    ),

    NOW()
)
RETURNING
    id AS processing_error_id,

    organization_id,

    error_stage,
    error_code,
    error_message,

    severity,
    status,

    retry_count,

    workflow_name,
    workflow_execution_id,

    context,

    occurred_at,

    (context->>'requires_alert')::boolean
        AS requires_alert;

parameters.query:
SELECT
    ss.id AS setting_id,
    ss.setting_key,
    ss.setting_value AS alert_recipient,
    ss.is_enabled,

    $1::uuid AS processing_error_id,
    $2::text AS error_code,
    $3::text AS error_message,
    $4::text AS severity,
    $5::text AS status,
    $6::text AS workflow_name,
    $7::text AS workflow_execution_id,
    $8::timestamptz AS occurred_at,

    $9::jsonb AS error_context

FROM public.system_settings ss

WHERE ss.setting_key = 'SYSTEM_ALERT_EMAIL'
  AND ss.is_enabled = true

LIMIT 1;
